text: Ko ɓen woni muññiiɓe ɓen e kala golle ɗoftaare, e tertagol boneeji, e kala musiiba heɓoowo ɓe; ko ɓen woni goonguɓe e yeewtereeji mun e ka kuuɗe mun, ko ɓen kadi woni ɗoftoriiɓe Alla no timmiri. Ko ɓen woni nafqooɓe jawle mun e laawol Alla, insinotooɓe ka sakkitoode jemma; sabu ko du'agol e on saa'i ɓurata jaabagol, heŋtina=yeewna ɓernde nden e sokolaaji.
